Q3. The power of a lens of focal length +25 cm is:

[1]

+25 cm फोकस दूरी वाले लेंस की क्षमता है:

(a) +0.25 D(b) +4 D(c) −4 D(d) +2.5 D

Q14. An object is placed 20 cm in front of a convex lens of focal length 12 cm. Find the position and nature of the image.

[2]

12 cm फोकस दूरी वाले उत्तल लेंस के सामने 20 cm की दूरी पर एक वस्तु रखी है। प्रतिबिंब की स्थिति एवं प्रकृति ज्ञात कीजिए।

MARKING SCHEME · EVALUATOR COPY Class X · Science (Physics) · Set-A (31/1/1) · Confidential
  • Q3. (b) +4 D  ·  P = 1f = 10.25 m1

Q14. Value points

  • Lens formula: 1v − 1u = 1f½
  • u = −20 cm, f = +12 cm ⇒ 1v = 112 − 120 = 130½
  • v = +30 cm — beyond 2F₂, on the other side½
  • m = v/u = −1.5 ⇒ real, inverted, magnified½

✔ Accept any sign-convention-consistent method. Deduct ½ for missing units.

State Fee Regulation Act — legal compliance note

Any parent-facing programme modelled here must be strictly optional, transparently priced, collected separately and never bundled into tuition, annual or development fees. Before launch, confirm it is permitted under your State's school fee regulation law — for example the Maharashtra Educational Institutions (Regulation of Fee) Act, 2011; the Gujarat Self-Financed Schools (Regulation of Fees) Act, 2017; the Rajasthan Schools (Regulation of Fee) Act, 2016; the Uttar Pradesh Self-Financed Independent Schools (Fee Regulation) Act, 2018; or the Tamil Nadu Schools (Regulation of Collection of Fee) Act, 2009 — and under your board's affiliation bye-laws, and place it before your PTA / School Management Committee wherever the law requires. GCC schools should follow their regulator's fee framework (e.g. KHDA in Dubai, ADEK in Abu Dhabi). No student may be compelled to enrol or be disadvantaged for opting out.

Illustrative planning aid only — not legal, tax or financial advice. Consult qualified counsel before implementation.

    Policies

    Privacy, Terms & Refunds

    Last updated: October 2026

    1. Who we are

    10x Educator Studio (aloknayak.com) is an independent education-technology platform operated by Alok Nayak (“we”, “us”). For the limited personal data described below, we act as the Data Fiduciary under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (“DPDP Act”).

    2. What we process

    • Your studio work stays on your device. Papers, settings and your saved library are kept in your browser's local storage and are not uploaded to our servers.
    • Payments: Razorpay processes card, UPI, NetBanking and wallet payments. We receive the payment ID, plan, amount and the name, email or phone you enter at checkout — never card numbers, UPI PINs or banking passwords.
    • Manual UPI: the UTR number, name and WhatsApp number you choose to send us for verification.
    • Cloud AI (Beta): when you tap “Add Extra Cloud AI Questions”, only curriculum parameters (board, class, subject, topic) are sent to the AI service to generate questions.

    3. Children's data

    The platform is built for teachers, tutors and school leaders. We do not knowingly collect personal data of children. Please do not enter student names, roll numbers or other identifiers into the studio or AI prompts. We do not undertake tracking, behavioural monitoring or targeted advertising directed at children (DPDP Act, Section 9).

    4. Purpose & retention

    We use personal data only to deliver the service, verify payments, provide support and meet legal obligations such as tax records, and we retain it only for as long as those purposes require. We do not sell personal data and do not use advertising cookies.

    5. Your rights

    Under the DPDP Act you may request a summary of your personal data, its correction, completion, updating or erasure, grievance redressal, and nominate another person to exercise these rights. You may withdraw consent at any time. Clearing your browser's site data deletes every locally saved paper instantly.

    6. Grievance redressal

    Contact us through the WhatsApp support link on this site. We respond within the timelines prescribed under the DPDP Act and its Rules. If your grievance remains unresolved, you may approach the Data Protection Board of India.

    1. Independent platform

    10x Educator Studio is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or acting on behalf of CBSE, CISCE, NCERT, IBO, Cambridge International or any government body. Board and framework names describe curriculum alignment only. Papers generated here are original practice and assessment material — not official board papers.

    2. Your responsibility as an educator

    Review every paper, answer key and lesson plan before classroom use. Parametric and AI-generated content can contain errors, and you remain responsible for the final material you distribute.

    3. Licence

    • A Teacher Pass is for one individual educator. An Institutional Vault is for the staff of one school campus.
    • You may use the papers you create freely in your own classes and school.
    • You may not resell, sublicense or bulk-redistribute the platform, its engine or its question templates.

    4. Acceptable use

    Do not use the platform to facilitate examination malpractice, to present content as official board material, or to process students' personal data.

    5. Free Pilot & payments

    The 30-Day Free Pilot needs no card and never converts into a paid plan automatically. Passes are one-time payments and do not auto-renew.

    6. Availability & liability

    The service is provided “as is”. We work to keep it available but cannot guarantee uninterrupted access. To the extent permitted by law, our total liability is limited to the amount you paid for your current pass.

    7. Governing law & changes

    These terms are governed by the laws of India. We may update them; material changes will be shown on this page with a new “Last updated” date.

    7-Day Refund Policy

    Every paid pass is covered by a 7-day refund window. The 30-Day Free Pilot exists so you can evaluate the full studio before paying anything.

    Eligible

    • Requests made within 7 days of payment where the pass does not work as described.
    • Duplicate or accidental payments — always refunded in full.

    How to request

    Send your Razorpay Payment ID or UPI UTR with a short reason through WhatsApp support.

    Processing

    • Approved refunds are returned to the original payment method; Razorpay refunds usually reflect within 5–7 working days, depending on your bank.
    • Manual UPI payments are refunded to the same UPI ID.
    • The refunded pass is deactivated once the refund is processed.

    Not eligible

    • Requests made more than 7 days after payment.
    • The Free Pilot, which involves no payment.
